```yaml
name: Agent Deep Modeling

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *' # Runs at every hour on the hour

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Save user messages
        run: |
          #!/bin/bash
          # Assuming you have a script to save user messages
          ./scripts/save-user-messages.sh

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: '.'
          commit: 'Save user messages'
          push: true
```
